updated_lifecycle_sequence: Discovery -> Visibility -> Governance -> Operationalization -> Enterprise Execution Assurance -> Evidence -> Continuous Assurance -> Operational Trust

enterprise_execution_assurance.purpose: Evaluate whether AI-generated recommendations were translated into enterprise actions safely, correctly, under policy, and with complete evidence.
enterprise_execution_assurance.core_question: Was the AI recommendation executed safely, correctly, under policy, and with complete evidence?
enterprise_execution_assurance.positioning_statement: Organizations are moving from AI that recommends to AI that acts. Enterprise Execution Assurance ensures those AI-driven actions are authorized, policy-enforced, traceable, reversible where required, monitored, evidenced, and reconstructable.
enterprise_execution_assurance.difference_from_evidence: Enterprise Execution Assurance checks the execution itself. Evidence proves the execution can be reconstructed.
